title: Computer vision deployments drive retail productivity gains
summary: Retailers are deploying computer vision technology to automate shelf tracking and address in-store execution failures that cost the industry billions annually. A Coresight Research study, partnered with Simbe and RELEX Solutions, quantifies the productivity gains and margin protection achieved through these hardware deployments.
problem_solved: Persistent in-store execution failures and shelf tracking gaps that erode retail margins.
why_valuable: Provides quantifiable ROI for retailers by automating physical inventory monitoring and reducing operational losses.
